_about: The A-Z of every TLD IANA records: what kind it is, who runs it, and
whether it is still in the root zone. Every category is derived from the
sources above; `categories` below says which fact each one rests on, and
that fact is on the record beside it.
There is no topical taxonomy here — no "Food & Drink", no "Tech". That
kind of grouping is editorial judgement, it is not derivable from the
root zone, and it is not copied from anyone who has made one. If ds ever
wants one it should be hand-maintained here like eligibility.json.
Generated by scripts/harvest-tld-facts.mjs. Do not edit by hand.

categories.generic: IANA Root Zone Database types it "generic"
categories.country-code: IANA Root Zone Database types it "country-code"
categories.sponsored: IANA Root Zone Database types it "sponsored"
categories.generic-restricted: IANA Root Zone Database types it "generic-restricted"
categories.infrastructure: IANA Root Zone Database types it "infrastructure"
categories.test: IANA Root Zone Database types it "test" — an IDN evaluation TLD, not registrable
categories.idn: the label is punycode — an internationalised TLD; `unicode` is how it reads
categories.unassigned: IANA lists no sponsoring organisation for it
categories.removed-from-root: IANA still records it but it is not in the current root zone — it used to resolve and no longer does
categories.brand: ICANN records Specification 13 — a brand TLD, closed to the public
categories.new-gtld: ICANN delegated it on or after 2013-10-23, when the 2013 round opened — see `delegated`
categories.contract-terminated: ICANN records the registry contract as terminated
categories.removed: ICANN records a removal date — see `removed`
categories.third-level: ICANN records registrations at the third level or lower
